test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A car covers a distance of 90 km in 50 min. What is its speed (in m/s)?
solution:
**Used data:**

Distance = 90 km

Time = 50 min

**Calculation:**

Time = 50over 60 hrs = 5over 6 hr.

Speed in km/hr = 90over {5over 6} = 108 km/hr

Speed in m/s = 108 × 5over 18 = 30 m/s

∴ **The speed in m/s is 30 m/s.**
